title: Fraunhofer Prototype
abstract: A web app that helps hybrid teams plan their office week and improve their team measures with AI feedback on survey data, built by the WORK:AI:TION team (Tjark, Victoria, Rouben and Lisa) during the Fraunhofer Summercamp 2025 with a FastAPI backend, prompt templates for the AI insights and a plain HTML frontend.
highlight: The prototype won the awards for best UX, transferability and scalability potential.

demos.alt: Team measures view with AI feedback
